verdicts.decision_note: The mismatch report establishes the implementation-relevant expectation that BigQuery gross revenue agree with the established dashboard value.
The mismatch was observed without a selected date range, so it does not demonstrate failure under the Requirement's same-date-range acceptance condition.
The client establishes the implementation-relevant comparison condition that gross revenue accuracy must be evaluated with the applicable date range selected.
First concrete verification: the client confirms that the gross revenue values match and identifies the missing date-range selection that caused the earlier discrepancy.
